mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reservaId, r.codigo, r.cliente_id AS clienteId, r.proveedor_id AS proveedorId, r.servicio_id AS servicioId, r.modalidad_entrega AS modalidadEntrega, r.precio_total AS precioTotal, r.fecha_inicio AS fechaInicio, r.hora_inicio AS horaInicio FROM reserva r WHERE r.id = #{reservaId} AND r.deleted = FALSE

SELECT p.id, p.nombre, p.descripcion, p.tipo_descuento AS tipo, p.valor_descuento AS valor, p.fecha_inicio AS fechaInicio, p.fecha_fin AS fechaFin FROM promocion p WHERE p.proveedor_id = #{proveedorId} AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.activa = TRUE AND NOW() BETWEEN p.fecha_inicio AND p.fecha_fin AND (p.limite_usos IS NULL OR p.usos_actuales < p.limite_usos) ORDER BY p.fecha_fin ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(m.costo_adicional, 0.00) FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.modalidad = #{modalidad} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE LIMIT 1
